§01 Executive Summary
Ownership Is the Model.
For the last decade, talent has primarily monetized audience trust through endorsements, sponsorships, and promotional arrangements. These activities generate revenue. They do not build enterprise value. The next generation of talent businesses will be built through ownership — not access.
"Endorsements liquidate attention.
Ownership compounds it."
The proposed partnership combines three complementary assets: OpenLoop Health brings healthcare infrastructure, clinical operations, regulatory compliance, and technology fulfillment. Talent brings audience trust, cultural relevance, and consumer attention at scale. Intellectual Asset Management brings venture creation, transaction structuring, talent representation, marketing execution, and enterprise administration.
The Three Assets
A Triad Built on Convergence.
OpenLoop Health

Talent

Cultural relevance, consumer attention, and brand equity that endorsements cannot manufacture and commissions cannot sustain.

§02 About Intellectual Asset Management
Trust Compounds. Everything Else Depreciates.
Trust
Attention

Enterprise Value
Intellectual Asset Management is a venture creation and operating platform. IAM was founded on a specific conviction: the most valuable asset talent possesses is not content — it is trust.
Traditional agencies monetize access. Traditional management firms monetize careers. IAM structures ownership — co-ownership vehicles, loyalty equity, and long-horizon brand equity for the most culturally significant talent of this generation. We arrive with a term sheet, not a pitch.

§03 Market Opportunity
Healthcare Is Becoming a Consumer Category.
Telehealth adoption, subscription-based care models, personalized medicine, and direct-to-consumer healthcare have fundamentally altered how consumers engage with providers. Simultaneously, consumers increasingly rely on trusted figures — not institutions — when making purchasing decisions.
The convergence of healthcare infrastructure and audience trust creates scalable enterprises capable of serving millions of consumers.
Healthcare infrastructure providers possess clinical expertise and operational capability. Talent possesses audience trust and distribution. Neither asset independently creates maximum value. Combined, and properly structured, they create something new: a scalable category-defining healthcare enterprise.

§12
A repeatable platform.
Not a single endorsement.
The objective is not to execute one celebrity-led venture. The objective is to establish a repeatable platform capable of launching multiple talent-led healthcare enterprises — scalable businesses with meaningful enterprise value, structured around ownership rather than attention.

IAM intends to serve as the platform architect responsible for scaling that vision.
